description: This file defines a configuration class 'Config' for the Confluence format in the Daux documentation generator project. It manages retrieval and setting of various configuration options related to Confluence space IDs, authentication, page management, and other settings.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: A class extending BaseConfig that provides specific configuration options for the Confluence format, including page management, URLs, authentication, and space/page identifiers.

methods.name: shouldAutoDeleteOrphanedPages
methods.description: Returns whether orphaned pages should be automatically deleted, defaulting to false if not set.

methods.name: shouldPrintDiff
methods.description: Indicates if a diff should be printed, defaulting to false.

methods.name: getUpdateThreshold
methods.description: Retrieves the threshold for updates, defaulting to 2.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Gets the prefix used in the configuration.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL for Confluence.

methods.name: getSpaceId
methods.description: Fetches the space ID from the configuration.

methods.name: setSpaceId
methods.description: Sets the space ID in the configuration.

methods.name: hasAncestorId
methods.description: Checks if an ancestor ID is set.

methods.name: hasRootId
methods.description: Checks if a root ID is set.

methods.name: hasHeader
methods.description: Checks if a header value is set.

methods.name: createRootIfMissing
methods.description: Determines if the root should be created if it is missing, defaults to false.
